purpose: APP6 business policy values, versioned through policy_configurations / policy_configuration_versions (TBL-076 / TBL-077). Data only: the reader and the publishing caller are APP6-B01, exactly as APP4-G01 shipped its dataset and APP4-B01-C1 shipped the reader and publisher. No seed runner is introduced here.
idempotency: Upsert by the natural key policy_configurations.config_key (ensureKey), then append one version (publishVersion) only when the key is missing or the stored value has drifted. Versions are immutable; drift is corrected by appending, never by mutating history.

configurations.description: How long a sent quotation version stays acceptance-eligible (APP6-G01).
Deposit and remaining shares of an accepted quotation total (BR-005, D-013/D-014). Policy authority only: APP6 creates no order, obligation, attempt or payment (APP6-G01).

The agreement types whose effective version a customer must accept at design approval (GRD-008, CON-144). Type set is configuration so business may add or remove one without a schema change (APP6-G01).
